constructs.evidence: TSRX components and Octane hooks preserve the observable application lifecycle.
Public @octanejs/three Canvas, frame, camera, event, scene, material, and geometry APIs own the renderer behavior.
Public @octanejs/drei Stats, Instance, and Instances exports are consumed by the WebGL scene. The loading shell is app-owned because Loader depends on client-only renderer progress during SSR.
Application state uses public Octane hooks; no compatibility shim is embedded in the game.
Compiler-owned hook slots and renderer-specific .three.tsrx modules are structural only and preserve the behavior contract.
